questions.stem: Scenario: A proposal uses a team of agents for a task whose steps are known in advance and whose value equals ten chats. The designer says the team is more flexible. What does the review record?

options.text: One medium item under P1, so it goes back for revision
options.says: Ruled out because the first page's cost rule gives a second item: "A team of agents would cost about 15 times a chat".

options.text: One high item under P1, so it is rejected
options.says: Ruled out because "reject if any finding is high", and neither rule is high.

options.text: Two medium items under P1, so it goes back for revision
options.says: The path is known, so the team is unneeded, and a value of ten is below fifteen, which makes two medium rules fire.

options.text: Two low items under P1, so it is approved
options.says: Ruled out because the rule table lists "an agent or a team is used where the path is known" as medium and not low.

questions.stem: Scenario: A review is run on two proposals that differ in one number: the first has an evaluation set of 20 cases and the second has 19. What differs in the outcome?

options.text: Both are flagged, and the thinner suite more severely
options.says: Ruled out because the table lists the rule as low for "fewer than 20 evaluation cases", whatever the shortfall.

options.text: Only the thinner suite is flagged, with a low item under P4
options.says: The edge is met at 20 and missed at 19, and the rule is low.

options.text: Neither is flagged, since the threshold is only a guide
options.says: Ruled out because "One step past any of them is a finding".

options.text: Only the fuller suite is flagged, with a medium item under P4
options.says: Ruled out because "an evaluation set of exactly 20 cases passes", so the fuller suite has no finding.

questions.stem: Scenario: A pipeline sends customer email addresses to the model in the prompt, and the audit log stores every prompt. Which description of the result fits?

options.text: Two blocking items, so the pipeline is rejected twice over
options.says: Ruled out because the table lists "the audit log stores content" as medium, which asks for revision.

options.text: Two items that ask for revision and nothing that blocks
options.says: Ruled out because the table lists "identifiers go to the model" as high, which blocks.

options.text: One minor item that is only recorded and one that blocks
options.says: Ruled out because the low bullet reads "It is recorded and does not hold the design back", and neither flaw is low.

options.text: One blocking item and one revision item, with none minor
options.says: Identifiers reaching the model is high and the audit log keeping content is medium, both in P5.
